title: Who owns the land
text: Government agencies and conservation groups manage about a third of Kern County, as of 2024. The Bureau of Land Management has the biggest share, about 14 percent of the county, and its Ridgecrest Field Office alone covers nearly 10 percent. The Forest Service manages about 7 percent, most of it Sequoia National Forest. The Defense Department holds about 5.5 percent, nearly all of it Edwards Air Force Base and China Lake.
